texts.content: {"styles":[{"range":[0,40],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"근데 그건 내가 얘기할 수 있는 거지"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,42],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"내가 처음 찍은 위치에 내려 달라 했지"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,52],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"당신 와이프는 이렇게 전 부인 챙기는 건 알아?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,54],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"우리 와이프는 당신처럼 그렇게 예민한 사람 아니야"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,56],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"즉 개인 간의 정보 전달도 가능할 것으로 생각됩니다"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,52],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"나쁜 생각을 하면 안 되는 세상이 올지도 모르죠"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,46],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"- 아, 뭐 해? 빨리 따라가 봐 - 응?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,56],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"'제가 권세정입니다' 이 한마디만 하고 오면 된다고"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,44],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"형은 지금 그 또라이의 지식을 훔친 거야"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,58],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"그 얄팍한 개별성 때문에 발생하는 질투, 경쟁, 의심"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,66],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"아, 좌측으로 돌아서 올라가시면은 컨퍼런스장 바로 나옵..."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,62],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"오늘 이 건물에서 생물학적 테러가 있다는 정보가 있었어요"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,52],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"저 사람들은 아마 그 테러의 영향인 거 같습니다"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,40],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"- 나, 나, 난 못 해 - 오라고?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,54],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"저희 회사가 주력하는 사업이 집단 지성이라고 하면"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,66],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"'IT 회사도 아닌 바이오 회사가 집단 지성을 연구하느냐?'"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,48],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"본인 몸에 백신을 주사해 놓은 상태라고 해요"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,60],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"그놈을 찾아 데리고 나간다면 다 같이 구조될 수 있어요"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,64],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"오늘 이 빌딩에서 열린 세미나에 참석했다는 얘기가 있었는데"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,56],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"그들이 만일 정보 교류를 하는 집단 지성체 상태라면"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,56],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"우리가 잘못된 정보를 입력시킬 수도 있을 거 같아요"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,50],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"아, 그래서 뭐, 어떻게 잘못된 정보를 주나?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,58],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"공기 중에 통신망이 섞여서 교류가 더 빨라질 텐데요?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,52],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"우리보다 저 새끼가 더 중요하다는 거야, 뭐야?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,48],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"아니, 저, 저 백신을 어떻게 데리고 나가?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,48],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"아, 근데 거기서 걔를 어떻게 꺼내 오냐고?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,60],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"이 건물 전체 CCTV 볼 수 있는 통제실 어디 있어?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,48],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"넌 이 빌딩 보안 팀이니까 잘 알 거 아니야"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,66],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"걔가 지금 실시간으로 어디로 이동하고 있는지 알 수가 있잖아"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,44],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"아마 저 사람이 첫 번째 감염자일 거예요"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,62],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"지금까지와는 전혀 다른 새로운 정보들을 받고 있는 거예요"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,54],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"안전한 길 계속 알려 드릴게요 아까 그 단톡방으로"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,40],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"아, 이 미친 새끼 왜 그러는 거야?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,50],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"여기서 살아서 나갈 수 있다고 생각하시나 봐요"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,44],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"저놈들하고 소통할 수 있게 된 거 같아요"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,48],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"이 새끼가 밖에 있는 괴물 같은 새끼들을 다"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,46],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"그 무슨 화학 무기에 감염돼서 갇혀 있는데"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,62],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"이렇게 계속 기다리라고 하면 도대체 언제까지 기다리라고요"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,52],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"나머지 놈들 행동을 멈출 수 있다 이 얘기예요?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,40],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"어차피 저 사람 아니면 구조대 안 와"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,48],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"감염을 막을 수 있는 백신은 확보해야 됩니다"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,48],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"결국 그런 비극을 모두 막을 수 있는 방법은"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,56],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"진화가 덜된 너네들이 우리보다 나은 게 뭐가 있지?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,40],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"그냥 혼자 외톨이가 될 수 있는 거?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,38],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"뭐, 하실 건 다 하신 거 같으니까"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,42],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"자, 저, 교수님 좀 모셔 각자 위치해"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,62],"size":5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9686274509803922,0.9686274509803922,0.9607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"그래서 최초 감염자를 제거하면 해결될 거란 판단하에..."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,54],"size":6,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.9411764705882353,0.7607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"이곳에 모인 사람들은 곧 끔찍한 실험에 갇힙니다."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,58],"size":6,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.9411764705882353,0.7607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"그리고 이 기술은 인간까지 하나로 연결할 수 있었죠."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,54],"size":6,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.9411764705882353,0.7607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"평범했던 인연은 곧 살아남아야 할 이유가 됩니다."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,42],"size":6,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.9411764705882353,0.7607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"단 한 명만 늦어도 모두가 죽는 작전."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,62],"size":6,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.9411764705882353,0.7607843137254902]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf"}}],"text":"마침내 찾은 서영철. 하지만 그는 구조를 원하지 않았죠."}
